title: A faithful cyclic orbit supplies a generating fixed-field extension
statement: Let Ω = AlgebraicClosure ℚ, let M be a finite-dimensional Galois intermediate field of Ω/ℚ, let u be a rational automorphism of M, and let ζ ∈ M. Assume that for every natural number n, if u^n fixes ζ then u^n is the identity automorphism. Then there exist an intermediate field F of M/ℚ and an F-automorphism h of M such that F(ζ) = M and h(x) = u(x) for every x ∈ M.
lean_statement: ∀ (M : IntermediateField ℚ (AlgebraicClosure ℚ)) [FiniteDimensional ℚ M] [IsGalois ℚ M] (u : M ≃ₐ[ℚ] M) (ζ : M), (∀ n : ℕ, (u ^ n) ζ = ζ → u ^ n = 1) → ∃ (F : IntermediateField ℚ M) (h : M ≃ₐ[F] M), IntermediateField.adjoin F ({ζ} : Set M) = ⊤ ∧ ∀ x : M, h x = u x
